## Tenant Email for a Leaking Bathroom Ceiling

Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/phone.svg

**Subject:** Urgent Maintenance Request: Bathroom Ceiling Leak in 2-Bedroom Apartment

Hello [Landlord/Property Manager Name],

I’m writing to report a leak in the bathroom ceiling of my 2-bedroom apartment in Toronto. The issue began on **2026-03-18** and has resulted in **visible water staining** on the ceiling.

At this time, I have not observed any electrical damage, but the leak appears to be active and may worsen if not addressed promptly. Please arrange for inspection and repair **within 72 hours**.

For documentation purposes, I am keeping a clear record of:
- the date the issue started
- the visible condition of the ceiling
- all messages related to this request
- any photos or videos I have taken

Please confirm receipt of this email and let me know the expected repair timeline.

Thank you,
[Your Full Name]
[Apartment Number]
[Phone Number]
[Email Address]

## Maintenance Request Checklist for Clear Documentation

Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/clipboard-check.svg

- Record the date and time you first noticed the leak: **2026-03-18**
- Take dated photos of the bathroom ceiling staining from multiple angles
- Take a short video if the leak is ongoing or actively dripping
- Note that there is **visible water staining** and **no electrical damage observed**
- Save copies of every email, text, or portal message sent to the landlord or property manager
- Send the request in writing and ask for confirmation of receipt
- State a clear repair deadline: **within 72 hours**
- If you speak by phone, follow up immediately with an email summarizing the call
- Keep a log of all responses, including names, dates, and times
- Recheck the area after any repair and document whether the stain or leak changes

## Paper Trail Template for Follow-Up

Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/journal-text.svg

Use this simple log format for each update:
- Date/Time:
- Who I contacted:
- Method:
- What I reported:
- What they promised:
- Next follow-up date:

## Quick Actions

Action: [Button: Copy Email]
Action: [Button: Copy Checklist]
